checks.name: three_native_platforms
checks.result: All three contract targets passed their own native execution of all 11 gates on the same clean source. System, architecture, pinned Rust 1.93.1 host, runner image, run/attempt and binary hashes are recorded.

checks.name: workspace_and_persistence
checks.result: Every workspace/all-targets build, native Rust suite, two doctests, complete ignored-entry inventory and explicit process-death-to-CLI recovery passed. Actual test-function counts are retained per platform; omitted Unix-only functions are not credited on Windows.

checks.name: portable_cli_and_mcp
checks.result: All eight CLI/MCP contracts and the manual checkpoint/resume lifecycle passed on each platform, together with nine native conditions: Unicode/spaced roots, CRLF intake, WAL/schema integrity, persisted sessions, source write receipts, stale-write preservation, rule updates, outside-source rejection and final closed-session health.

checks.name: real_platform_failures_fixed
checks.result: Retained the first failed run. Fixed Linux O_PATH directory synchronization using a readable handle relative to the held directory; added path-replacement regression. Fixed Rust/Python fixture teardown to close SQLite before removal. The final native run verifies both reusable fixes without removing assertions.

checks.name: source_and_receipt_binding
checks.result: GitHub job, artifact and full report identities match one source commit. Every declared gate log and subordinate receipt hash was checked. Windows contract CRLF bytes match the exact Git source conversion and remain recorded separately. Subsequent developer-use changes are limited to source-ledger progress and its generated index.

checks.name: actual_project_use
checks.result: Actual project Doctor preserved its schema, all 25 tables, revision and source. MCP observation/progress retained session and claim ownership, exact source edits, recovery snapshots and final attempt receipts. Context remains complete; only the intentionally active session remains.

checks.name: scope_and_planning
checks.result: Current planning validation passes. Platform validation does not complete business scenarios, native model clients, benchmark metrics or release readiness.

limitations: Native execution covers only macOS arm64, Linux x64 and Windows x64 in the recorded runner images. No other architecture, older OS or network filesystem result is implied.
Rust test counts are reported separately per native platform. Unix-specific tests omitted on Windows are not credited. Repeated tests are not business scenarios.
No native Agent model client, independent business reviewer, E4, performance metric or release is claimed. Process-kill recovery does not establish power-loss durability.
Full native reports and their tracked input manifests are retained locally and in the referenced GitHub artifacts. Public summaries bind them by hash; CI artifact expiry is recorded.
